item.nt_antiparasitedsc: 3-dose vial. Prophylaxis: while active, untreated foreign-body wounds will not spawn new parasites. Does not remove ones already burrowed — pull those out by hand or tweezers. Also lowers blood sickness / sepsis; costs liver health; after transplant speeds graft settling.
item.nt_important_chipdsc: Replacement board for the implanted health chip. Craft from a circuit board (≥90% condition) and string. Apply to clear chip faults.
item.nt_o2_condenserdsc: Reusable oxygen device. Empty, it restores blood oxygen and clears hyperventilation. With serum loaded, applying it also anesthetizes the patient for surgery. Serum inserts like a battery (does not repair the device); scissors or any hammer eject.
item.nt_retractordsc: Holds a surgical wound open. Required for internal procedures.
item.nt_scalpeldsc: Precise cutting instrument. Removes early necrotic tissue on an unconscious patient.
item.nt_scissorsdsc: Fine surgical scissors. Extract foreign bodies from wounds, and eject serum from an oxygen condenser (any hammering tool also works).
item.nt_serum_sleepdsc: Ampoule of anesthetic charge for the O2 condenser. Drag onto the condenser to load (like a battery). Does nothing by itself. Scissors or any hammer eject the charge back as an ampoule.
item.nt_bloodtype_opdsc: Yellow blood pack typed O+. Used for blood transfusion. Craft: blood bag + 20 mL alien blood.
item.nt_bloodtype_omdsc: Yellow blood pack typed O-. Used for blood transfusion. Craft: blood bag + 20 mL alien blood.
item.nt_bloodtype_apdsc: Yellow blood pack typed A+. Used for blood transfusion. Craft: blood bag + 20 mL alien blood.
item.nt_bloodtype_amdsc: Yellow blood pack typed A-. Used for blood transfusion. Craft: blood bag + 20 mL alien blood.
item.nt_bloodtype_bpdsc: Yellow blood pack typed B+. Used for blood transfusion. Craft: blood bag + 20 mL alien blood.
item.nt_bloodtype_bmdsc: Yellow blood pack typed B-. Used for blood transfusion. Craft: blood bag + 20 mL alien blood.
item.nt_bloodtype_abpdsc: Yellow blood pack typed AB+. Used for blood transfusion. Craft: blood bag + 20 mL alien blood.
item.nt_bloodtype_abmdsc: Yellow blood pack typed AB-. Used for blood transfusion. Craft: blood bag + 20 mL alien blood.

moodle.chronicpaindsc: Persistent pain from long-standing injuries or scar tissue.
moodle.feverdsc: Systemic fever from cold, sickness or sepsis. Does not develop with good immunity (≥100%).
moodle.fresh_suturedsc: Recently stitched wound. Fades on its own in ~60s.
moodle.frostbitedsc: Cold-damaged tissue. Progresses in cold environments.
moodle.frostbite_amputationdsc: Extremity frozen through. Necrosis grows rapidly until the limb is amputated.
moodle.hallucinationsdsc: Perceiving things that are not there. Builds first; psychosis follows if left untreated.
moodle.heartdamagedsc: Damaged heart muscle. Permanently reduces cardiac performance until surgery. At 100% triggers vanilla cardiac arrest; unconsciousness follows vanilla vitals.
moodle.kidney_deadlowdsc: Kidneys have shut down (organ damage ≥ 70%). Toxins flood the blood; trauma builds up over time.
moodle.kidneydamagedsc: Damage to kidney tissue. Reduces filtration and causes toxin buildup.
moodle.kidneyfailuredsc: Kidneys have stopped filtering. Toxins accumulate rapidly.
moodle.liverdamagedsc: Hepatocyte damage from alcohol, drugs, toxins or infection. Progressive; failure needs transplant.
moodle.liverfailuredsc: Liver can no longer clear toxins. Requires transplant.
moodle.lung_compressdsc: Lungs squeezed by heavy liquid (oil) with no scuba gear. Blocks inhalation.
moodle.lung_overexpanddsc: Alveoli forced open by rapid pressure change (nearby blast). Reduces breathing efficiency.
moodle.lung_wall_collapsedsc: Massive internal bleeding is buckling the lung walls inward. Bleeds worse and starves the blood of oxygen.
moodle.lungdamagedsc: Damaged alveoli. Reduces oxygenation and causes chronic cough.
moodle.lungdamage_severedsc: Alveoli are failing (lung damage ≥ 70%). Oxygen mask required.
moodle.necrosisdsc: Dead tissue on a limb. Early stage (< 70%): cut away with a scalpel or any cutting tool (improvised bleeds more). Severe: amputation only. Returns if tetanus/frostbite/sepsis are not treated.
moodle.parazitedsc: Parasites burrowed into an untreated porez4/5 foreign wound. Pull them out by hand (painful) or with tweezers. Anti-parasitic only prevents new burrows.
moodle.pechen_deaddsc: Liver has shut down (organ damage ≥ 70%). Toxins flood the blood; trauma builds. Transplant required.
moodle.pechen_warningdsc: Early liver strain (organ damage 10–40%). Often from drinking, overdose, sepsis or radiation.
moodle.pechen_warning2dsc: Worsening liver damage (40–70%). Transition toward failure — stop alcohol and clear toxins now.
moodle.platadead1stadiadsc: Oh… looks like a transistor burned out from something. UNI-HEALTH is starting to hiccup.
moodle.platadead2stadiadsc: Uh-oh — this is getting more serious than usual. Half the board is glitching; vitals may lie.
moodle.platadead3stadiadsc: Critical board failure. At ≥99% a 10-minute self-destruct fuse arms — replace the chip or it explodes.
moodle.pneumothoraxdsc: Air trapped between lung and chest wall. Requires chest drain.
moodle.porez1dsc: Shallow incision. Bleeds a little, closes slowly on its own or with Medical suture.
moodle.porez3dsc: Wound held open with a Retractor. Required precondition for debridement / amputation / transplant / chest drain.
moodle.porez4_foreigndsc: Laceration with something embedded inside. Won't close until removed with Scissors. Left untreated, parasites may burrow into this limb.
moodle.porez5_foreigndsc: Wide-open wound AND a foreign body inside. Extract first, then suture. Left untreated, parasites may burrow into this limb.
moodle.psychosisdsc: Breakdown of contact with reality. Follows prolonged hallucinations.
moodle.seizuredsc: Uncontrolled electrical activity in the brain. Aim shakes badly; rarely the body twitches or ignores controls for a moment.
moodle.tetanusdsc: Neurotoxin from dirty punctures — bites, spike traps, bear traps and other sharp wounds.
moodle.wrongblooddsc: Incompatible yellow blood. Adds to pulse/pressure; fever, kidney/liver stress, sickness.
moodle.antiparasite_guarddsc: Temporary protection — untreated porez4/5 wounds will not spawn new parasites while active.
moodle.liver_graftdsc: Recent liver transplant. Infection risk is elevated until the graft settles.
moodle.liver_soberdsc: Time without alcohol. Long abstinence allows the liver to recover.
moodle.chipdamagedsc: Damage to the implanted health chip. Causes UNI-HEALTH readout errors.
moodle.chip_fusedsc: Seconds left before the implant self-destructs. Console: nt_add chip_fuse N shortens the timer.

other.af.chronicpain.cures: inject morphine (each push: random ≤50 ml toward cure; careful of dependency)
other.af.fever.cures: antibiotics; combat injector (combatpen); helluce; keep immunity ≥100%
other.af.hyperventilation.cures: Calm the patient (raise mood, lower stress/adrenaline); morphine low dose
other.af.kidney_warning.cures: L.R.D.; antibiotics / combatpen; drink water; leave radiation
other.af.kidneydamage.cures: time; L.R.D. (УЛР); antibiotics / combatpen (sepsis); drink water; leave radiation
other.af.liverdamage.cures: stop alcohol; long sobriety; antibiotics / combatpen (sepsis); wait out overdose & radiation; anti-parasite after transplant
other.af.liverfailure.cures: surgery: liver transplant (organs ≥40%); then anti-parasite; no alcohol
other.af.lung_compress.cures: get out of oil, use scuba gear or Oxygen condenser
other.af.lungdamage.cures: Oxygen condenser; rest; surgery: lung transplant (organs ≥40%) if severe
other.af.lungdamage_severe.cures: Oxygen condenser urgently; reduce underlying lung damage
other.af.necrosis.cures: early (< 70%): Scalpel or any cutting tool → Remove dead tissue (improvised = more bleed); severe (≥ 70%): Bone saw → amputate
other.af.parazite.cures: WoundView: pull parasites (hands or tweezers); Scissors → extract foreign body; Anti-parasitic prevents new burrows only
other.af.pechen_dead.cures: urgent: Bone saw → liver transplant; then anti-parasite (infection prophylaxis); avoid alcohol
other.af.pechen_warning.cures: stop alcohol; antibiotics / combatpen; wait out overdose & radiation
other.af.pechen_warning2.cures: urgently stop alcohol; antibiotics / combatpen; wait out overdose & radiation
other.af.platadead1stadia.cures: Important chip (craft: circuit board ≥90% + string); reduce radiation / trauma / sepsis
other.af.pneumothorax.cures: Apply Chest drain to chest in UNI-HEALTH; or Retractor → Pleural drainage (surgery menu)
other.af.porez1.cures: Medical suture / Plastic bandage, or wait a few minutes
other.af.porez4_foreign.cures: Scissors → Extract foreign body (surgery); Anti-parasitic prevents burrow
other.af.porez5_foreign.cures: Scissors → Extract foreign body, then Medical suture; Anti-parasitic prevents burrow
other.af.tetanus.cures: time + wound cleanup; treat before necrosis (75%+)
other.af.wrongblood.cures: wait ~3 min; supportive care; never re-transfuse mismatched blood
